preconditions.description: N, M, and Q are within the specified upper bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(parent) == N - 1 and all(1 <= parent[i] <= i + 1 for i in range(N - 1))
preconditions.description: The parent array has exactly N-1 elements, where parent[i] is the parent of factory i+2 (1-based), and parent[i] < i+2.

preconditions.expression: len(B) == N and all(1 <= B[i] <= M for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: The B array has exactly N elements, where B[i] is the businessman (1-based) owning factory i+1.

preconditions.expression: len(threshold) == M and all(1 <= threshold[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: The threshold array has exactly M elements, where threshold[i] is the target amount for businessman i+1.

preconditions.expression: Q == len(queries) and all(1 <= F <= N and 1 <= X <= 10**6 and 0 <= D <= 10**6 for F, X, D in queries)
preconditions.description: The queries array has exactly Q elements, where each query is a tuple (F, X, D) with F being the factory (1-based), X the donation amount, and D the increment factor.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= F <= N for F, _, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: All factory indices F in queries are within the valid range [1, N].

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 or (line.split()[0].isdigit() and 1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= Q + 1) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line != 'rekt')
postconditions.description: For each businessman i (1-based), the output line is either 'rekt' or a year number (1-based) between 1 and Q+1, indicating the first year after which the businessman's cumulative earnings meet or exceed their threshold.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'rekt' or (1 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= Q + 1 and sum(earnings[B[j] - 1] for j in range(N) if B[j] == i + 1) >= threshold[i] after processing first int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) - 1 queries)) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: For each businessman i (1-based), if the output is not 'rekt', the cumulative earnings of all factories owned by businessman i after the specified year (inclusive) must meet or exceed their threshold. If 'rekt', the cumulative earnings never meet the threshold in Q years.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'rekt' or (1 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= Q + 1 and sum(earnings[B[j] - 1] for j in range(N) if B[j] == i + 1) < threshold[i] after processing first int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) - 2 queries)) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: For each businessman i (1-based), if the output is a year Y, the cumulative earnings of all factories owned by businessman i after Y-1 years must be below their threshold, ensuring Y is the first year the threshold is met.
